2025-06.daily_overview: Ended the camping trip on Mount Heng and returned to Changsha. Though physically tired, I felt relaxed. In the evening, I bought Dragon Boat Festival supplies and cat supplies, picked up the stray cat 'Baozi', and started a rhythm of studying at home and taking tutoring sessions. Facing an academic warning felt urgent, but the arrival of the new companion added warmth to life. In the evening, I did some simple yoga stretching.

events.name: Pack up camp and go down the mountain
events.description: At 6 a.m., Feng Haoran, Xie Yutong, and Peng Yuqing got up one after another, worked together to dismantle the tent, pack sleeping bags and moisture-proof pads, clean up campsite garbage and sort it into bags. Using a portable stove, they brewed coffee and oatmeal for breakfast, and ate it with compressed biscuits. After confirming no equipment was left behind, they hiked down the mountain with backpacks to the scenic area exit at 8 a.m., loaded the equipment into the car. Feng Haoran drove back to Changsha along the same route, stopping briefly at a service area to rest and buy water, arriving in downtown Changsha around 11 a.m. They dropped off Xie Yutong and Peng Yuqing near their respective residences, ending the Hengshan camping trip.

events.name: After the lunch break, I reassured my parents of my safety and organized photos.
events.description: After returning home, he washed up briefly, sent a WeChat message to his parents to let them know he was safe, and said he had made it back. He took a hot shower to relieve the fatigue of camping, then lay in bed and napped for an hour. After waking up, he picked a few photos from his phone from the camping trip and sent them to the three-person WeChat group with Xie Yutong and Peng Yuqing. The three chatted for a while and agreed to plan another short trip next time.

events.name: Evening supermarket shopping and bringing the cat home.
events.description: In the evening, I went to a supermarket near home and bought two bags of fresh meat zongzi, a pack of honey-date zongzi, and some summer fruits to prepare for spending the Dragon Boat Festival alone. Then I went to a pet shop near my home in Yuelu District to buy a cat bed, food bowl, litter box, cat litter, cat food, and other supplies, and cleaned a corner of the balcony as a temporary activity area for the cat. In the evening, I brought the stray cat "Baozi" home from the community rescue point, set up the cat bed, placed the food bowl and litter box, and guided Baozi to get familiar with the new environment. Baozi was wary upon entering the room and hid in a corner to observe. Feng Haoran did not force close contact, left food and water, and then left to let the cat adapt on its own.

events.name: Make up a plan for catching up on classes and begin CFA and MBA course studies.
events.description: After receiving the academic warning email, immediately made a detailed catch-up plan based on the course syllabus and missing content, and organized online course videos and reference materials. From 19:00-22:00 in the evening, first summarized the chapters of CFA Derivatives and Alternative Investments in the study, sorted out the knowledge framework, then reviewed the missed MBA course videos on the online course platform, carefully took notes, and completed the accompanying exercises. After studying, my eyes felt sore, but I felt somewhat relieved to have made up for the progress.

events.name: Simple evening yoga stretching.
events.description: Feeling stiff during a study break, I remembered I hadn't done yoga today, so I spread out the mat in the living room and followed a phone video for 15 minutes of basic Hatha stretching, focusing on relaxing my shoulders, neck, and legs.

start_state.location: Campsite near Zhurong Peak on Mount Heng
start_state.mood: Content but somewhat tired

end_state.location: At home in Yuelu District, Changsha
end_state.mood: Physically tired but mentally fulfilled. I feel both anticipation and a bit at a loss about the new member's arrival. After yoga, my muscles are relaxed.

state.daily_exercise: Hiked down the mountain for about 1.5 hours, and did 15 minutes of evening yoga

2025-06.daily_overview: Alone at home during the Dragon Boat Festival, he took Baozi for a check-up in the morning, cleaned camping gear in the afternoon, boiled zongzi in the evening, and had a video call with his parents, caring for each other. Despite homesickness, the family bond was warm. At night, he wrote in his diary to record his feelings and prepared to resume his morning running plan. In the evening, he practiced yoga to relax.

events.name: Take stray cat Baozi for a physical examination and vaccination
events.description: In the morning, he packed Baozi into a pet airline crate and drove to Ruipeng Pet Hospital in Kaifu District, Changsha. He explained to the doctor that Baozi was a stray cat. The doctor performed a full basic physical examination on Baozi (including checks of temperature, weight, fur, mouth, ear canal, etc.) and completed the first FVRCP vaccination. The doctor advised observing the vaccine reaction and told him that internal and external deworming would be needed one week later. After paying the fee, he took Baozi home. On the way, Baozi appeared nervous in the airline crate. After returning home, he placed Baozi back in the cat bed area, and Baozi seemed in good spirits. On the way, he also bought a small jingle ball as a toy at a pet store.

events.name: Wash, dry, and organize camping gear
events.description: After returning home, took out the tent, sleeping bags, and other gear to air them on the balcony, washed the muddy outdoor cookware and utensils, checked equipment for wear, and restocked the first aid kit. Stored the dried gear in the storage cabinet by category, edited camping photos on the phone and sent them to the three-person WeChat group, then selected a few favorites to print and put in the photo album.

events.name: Cooking a Dragon Boat Festival zongzi dinner by myself
events.description: In the evening, in the kitchen, I cooked the fresh meat zongzi and candied date zongzi in a pot according to the package instructions. After cooking, I took photos of the zongzi, paired them with my own pour-over coffee, and enjoyed the Dragon Boat Festival dinner alone at the dining table—simple but full of ritual. Afterwards, I also sent the zongzi photos to my parents.

events.name: Video call with parents to check on their health
events.description: At around 8 p.m., he had a nearly one-hour video call with his parents at their home in Wuhan via WeChat. He asked in detail about his father Feng Jianguo's blood pressure control after switching antihypertensive medication, and reminded his mother Li Xiuying to keep a light diet and eat less greasy food in summer. He showed the freshly cooked zongzi and Dragon Boat Festival dinner to reassure his parents. His mother in turn asked about his neck condition, and Feng Haoran replied that everything was fine, sharing only the good news and not the worries.

events.name: Wrote in diary and prepared the morning run plan.
events.description: After the video call ended, I sat quietly at the desk for a few minutes, feeling a touch of homesickness, but more relief that my parents were in good health. I opened the photo album on my phone and looked through old family photos taken during a previous trip to Wuhan. Then I briefly recorded my feelings about this Dragon Boat Festival in my diary and planned to visit my parents in Wuhan during the next long holiday. Next, I checked my morning running gear, including the battery and functions of my running shoes, sportswear, and fitness band, confirmed the morning run appointment with Gao Yunfei, set my phone alarm to 6:30 a.m., and listed a morning running plan for every Tuesday, Thursday, and Saturday in my memo.

events.name: Evening Hatha yoga practice
events.description: After the video call, realizing he had not exercised yet that day, he laid out the yoga mat on the balcony and did 20 minutes of Hatha yoga, focusing on stretching the shoulders, neck, and back, feeling relaxed in body and mind.

start_state.location: At home in Yuelu District, Changsha
start_state.mood: Lazy, relaxing during the holiday

end_state.location: At home in Yuelu District, Changsha
end_state.mood: Although a little homesick, the healthy family interactions made him feel at ease.

2025-06.daily_overview: A day interwoven with work, study, rock climbing, sibling conflict, and a filial purchase. In the morning, a morning run with a running buddy set a regular rhythm; during the day, routine work was handled; in the evening, rock climbing came first and then study; late at night, a heated argument with his younger sister caused an emotional rollercoaster, which then sparked the initiative to buy a smart wristband due to an oversight in his father's health.

events.name: Morning run with running partner Gao Yunfei
events.description: At 6:30 in the morning, I met Gao Yunfei at Lushan South Road for the agreed Tuesday morning run. We jogged about 5 kilometers along the foot of Yuelu Mountain. On the way, Gao Yunfei talked about the latest in the IT industry, and Feng Haoran shared some camping anecdotes. However, because he had studied late the previous night and was a bit fatigued, he struggled to keep up in the second half of the run.

events.name: Handle client consultations and group discussions on workdays
events.description: Arrived at the company at 9 o'clock. In the morning, handled asset allocation consultations from several clients. Among them, Lin Zhihao expressed concerns about recent tech sector fluctuations; Feng Haoran patiently explained and promised to provide adjustment suggestions within this week. During the lunch break, he dined with colleague Zheng Wenbo at the Hunan restaurant downstairs and discussed possible paths for the pilot promotion of cross-border REITs. In the afternoon, he had a preliminary discussion with the MBA group via WeChat about the division of work for next week's marketing presentation, but only spoke briefly due to a heavy workload.

events.name: Evening rock climbing training
events.description: After work, went directly to the climbing gym in Yuelu District for a 1.5-hour training session with the coach, focusing on V2 routes and finger strength. Felt good and successfully completed two new V2 routes. After training, my upper limbs were sore but I felt a great sense of accomplishment.

events.name: Evening: study CFA course
events.description: After climbing, went home for a simple dinner. Studied from 20:30 to 21:30, focusing on reviewing the derivatives chapter and sorting out important formulas; efficiency was decent. During study breaks, played with the cat. Baozi is no longer as afraid of him and will cautiously approach.

events.name: Late-night call from younger sister triggers conflict
events.description: Shortly after the study session ended, late at night, his younger sister Feng Xinran called from Shanghai, crying that she had been laid off by her internet company that day. Instead of comforting her first, Feng Haoran directly suggested, in the tone of a career mentor, that she take the CFA exam and switch to the finance industry; his tone was blunt and lacked empathy. Feeling denied and blamed, Feng Xinran became even more upset and hung up angrily. The relationship between the siblings reached an impasse. Feng Haoran sat in a daze for a moment, then realized he had spoken inappropriately and felt deeply frustrated.

events.name: Learned about my father's health oversight and selected a smart wristband
events.description: After a phone call with his younger sister, he had trouble falling asleep, so he opened WeChat and had a video call with his father, Feng Jianguo. During the chat, he learned that his father had recently occasionally forgotten to measure his blood pressure. He realized the importance of health monitoring and resolved to choose a smart bracelet for his father as a Father's Day gift. After the call, he immediately used his laptop in the study to browse e-commerce platforms such as JD.com and Huawei Mall, looked up product details and user reviews of several smart bracelets, focusing on comparing health features such as blood pressure monitoring, heart rate detection, and fall alarm. He finally chose the Huawei Band 8, placed an order on JD.com, filled in his own location as the delivery address, chose standard express delivery, and noted that an invoice and gift wrapping were required.

start_state.mood: Clear-minded in the morning, ready to execute the plan

end_state.location: At home in Yuelu District, Changsha
end_state.mood: Felt regretful and irritable due to conflict with younger sister, but felt somewhat reassured through shopping

He began to feel slight neck discomfort from sitting for long periods but still did not take it seriously. His mood was somewhat low because yesterday's conflict had not yet dissipated.

events.name: Handle client proposals in the morning

At the same time, I followed up on Huang Siqi's account change request and had a 30-minute video call with her.

events.name: Chatting with the coffee shop owner during lunch break

Shen Xinyi mentioned the latte art experience class in mid-June, and Feng Haoran readily agreed to join. Although it was lightly raining, the café was cozy.

Remembering that Wednesday was yoga day, I spread out the mat at home and followed a video for 1 hour of Hatha yoga, focusing on shoulder, neck, and balance poses, including headstand preparation. Felt improved body flexibility.

events.name: Evening study and neck discomfort
events.description: In the evening from 20:00 to 22:30, in the study, reviewed key chapters of the course video, took detailed notes, and solved practice problems. Midway through studying, his cervical spine began to feel sore and swollen. He wanted to get up and move around but only simply turned his neck and continued working at the desk. After studying, he did a few minutes of shoulder and neck stretches, with average results.

start_state.mood: Somewhat gloomy, thinking back to last night's argument with my younger sister.

2025-06.daily_overview: Received and sent out the smart bracelet. Morning run was not in good shape. In spare time, considered proactively repairing the relationship with my younger sister. After evening rock climbing, studied while editing an apology WeChat message; my mood gradually calmed through action.

events.name: After the morning run, received a smart band.
events.description: At 6:30 in the morning, I went for a morning run with Gao Yunfei. Because I wasn't in good shape, I only ran 4 kilometers and ended early. After returning home, I happened to receive the Huawei Band 8 delivered by JD.com. I opened the package, charged the band, and set it up after powering it on. I tested functions such as blood pressure measurement, heart rate monitoring, and sleep monitoring. After confirming the product was of good quality, I restored it to factory settings.

events.name: Afternoon: sent out the wristband and handled work
events.description: In the morning I went to work as usual and handled routine matters. During the lunch break, I wrote a Father's Day greeting card by hand (content: Dad, Happy Father's Day! The smart bracelet can help you measure your blood pressure anytime, take care of yourself!), and sent the bracelet and card together via SF Express to my father's home in Wuhan, paying the shipping fee and purchasing insurance service to ensure delivery by June 15. In the afternoon, I attended a short internal training meeting.

events.name: Evening rock climbing training
events.description: After work in the afternoon, I went to the climbing gym. This session, I tried the V2+ route. Although I partially failed, my finger strength improved. Because I wasn't in good condition, I ended early, training for about 1 hour. When leaving, I exchanged a few words with climbing friends.

events.name: Evening study and editing apology WeChat message
events.description: After rock climbing, went home for a quick wash, started studying at 20:00, reviewed the remaining CFA derivatives content, and completed some practice problems. After studying, sat in a chair and repeatedly thought about my sister's feelings, realizing that I was too rational and lacked emotional support. Looked through my sister's past WeChat Moments, recalled our close relationship, and decided to apologize proactively. Carefully edited a long WeChat message, sincerely apologizing for my attitude and tone, and invited my sister to let down her guard and talk about her true feelings. But I haven't sent it yet, planning to wait one more calm night.

start_state.mood: Refreshed after an early morning run

2025-06.daily_overview: The reconciliation with my sister was gratifying, a small progress at work brought encouragement, physical therapy during lunch break, and in the evening I ran into Shen Xinyi at an outdoor jazz concert. Music, friends, and a slight buzz from plum wine temporarily dispelled stress, and the unexpected popularity of a photo also brought a small sense of accomplishment.

events.name: Send an apologetic WeChat message and reconcile with my sister.
events.description: In the morning, he sent the apology WeChat message that he had edited the night before to Feng Xinran. After reading the apology, Feng Xinran's mood softened, and she replied with her grievances and confusion about the future. The two had an in-depth conversation via WeChat voice call for about an hour. Feng Haoran patiently listened to his younger sister's dissatisfaction with the layoffs, her fear of career transition, and her real concerns about taking the CFA exam. Feng Haoran said he respects whatever decision she makes and is willing to provide financial support and career advice. The siblings eventually reached mutual understanding, and their relationship gradually recovered.

events.name: Learned about the preliminary approval of the cross-border solution pilot on a workday
events.description: In the morning at the company, I received a notice that the pilot application for the cross-border REITs distribution plan had received preliminary approval, and overseas market data needed to be supplemented before next week. I had a brief communication with my superior Qian Yongqiang, who affirmed the progress and reminded me to pay attention to details. During lunch break, I shared the news with Zheng Wenbo, who congratulated me.

events.name: Lunch break physical therapy
events.description: During lunch break, he went to the Rehabilitation Department of Xiangya Third Hospital for weekly physical therapy. The doctor manually relaxed his neck muscles, taught him new McKenzie exercises, and reminded him to watch his posture. The treatment lasted about 40 minutes. Afterward, his neck felt much lighter.

events.name: Going to the open-air jazz concert in the evening.
events.description: In the afternoon, after finishing work early, he changed into casual clothes, grabbed his camera, checked his cervical spine mobility, and prepared for the evening event. At 18:30, he left home, took the metro to Yuelu Mountain East Gate Station, walked up the mountain, and arrived at the open-air venue of the 'Hilltop Concert Hall' at 19:00. Along the way, he confirmed the meeting point with Peng Yuqing by phone.

events.name: Met Shen Xinyi by chance at the concert and shared plum wine
events.description: At 19:30 the concert officially began. Sitting on the grass with Peng Yuqing, we listened to an improvised performance of saxophone and piano, enjoying the breeze and the evening glow. During the intermission, we ran into Shen Xinyi. I introduced Peng Yuqing and Shen Xinyi, and the three of us sat on the lawn, sharing the homemade plum wine Shen Xinyi had brought, chatting about music and coffee. In the second half, I used my phone to take a few silhouette photos of the musicians under the stage lights, trying different angles to capture the saxophonist's expression while playing. The concert ended at 21:30. The three of us applauded together in thanks, said goodbye, and walked down the mountain.

events.name: Go home, import photos, and take care of the cat.
events.description: Arrived home at 22:30, quickly washed up, first checked Baozi's food bowl and water, played with it for a while with the bell ball, then imported the camera photos to the computer, selected a few satisfactory shots, and planned to process them tomorrow. Lying on the sofa, I scrolled through WeChat Moments, savoring the afterglow of the concert.

2025-06.daily_overview: On Wednesday, an acute attack of cervical disc herniation forced Feng Haoran to seek emergency medical treatment. He then followed the doctor's advice to buy a home traction device, communicated with his supervisor about work adjustments in the afternoon, and received a greeting from his classmate Xie Yutong in the evening, beginning his systematic rehabilitation journey.

events.name: Acute cervical spine flare-up requiring emergency medical attention.
events.description: At 7 a.m., Feng Haoran suddenly felt severe neck pain upon getting up, had difficulty turning his head, and his right arm was numb. He immediately called a ride-hailing car to rush to the emergency department of the Rehabilitation Department of the Fourth Hospital of Changsha. On the way, he called his colleague Zheng Wenbo to explain the situation and asked him to help submit a temporary leave request.

events.name: Hospital diagnosis and treatment plan
events.description: In the rehabilitation department, after a detailed consultation and physical examination, the doctor arranged a cervical spine X-ray. Half an hour later, the results showed an acute onset of C5-C6 disc herniation compressing the nerve root, causing arm numbness. The doctor prescribed ibuprofen sustained-release capsules, mecobalamin tablets, and other medications, and arranged physical therapy three times a week (traction, medium-frequency electrotherapy, ultrasound), with the first treatment scheduled for the afternoon of June 23. Feng Haoran carefully recorded the precautions, feeling heavy-hearted and worried that his career would be affected.

events.name: Buy a cervical traction device
events.description: After leaving the hospital, Feng Haoran remembered the doctor's suggestion of home traction, so he asked the driver to detour to the medical equipment market on Furong Middle Road in Kaifu District. In the store, he picked a medical cervical traction device (680 yuan), learned the correct wearing method and precautions from the clerk, and adjusted the tightness on the spot. He carried the traction device back, smiling wryly at the thought that he needed such equipment at such a young age.

events.name: Communication with supervisor about work adjustment
events.description: After returning home in the afternoon, Feng Haoran called his direct supervisor, Qian Yongqiang, explained his illness and the doctor's orders in detail, and requested to arrive one hour late and leave one hour early every day for the next two weeks, and to work remotely for half a day on physical therapy days. Qian Yongqiang expressed understanding and full support, agreed to hand over some urgent work to Zheng Wenbo, and urged him to prioritize recovery. Feng Haoran then submitted the request in the OA system.

events.name: Greeting from classmate Xie Yutong
events.description: In the evening, classmate Xie Yutong learned he was ill and sent a message to ask how he was. Feng Haoran merely said it was an old problem, unwilling to say more.

events.name: Design and create a financial dashboard framework
events.description: 20:10 Created a new Excel workbook and planned a multi-sheet dashboard: the income sheet categorizes by salary, investment, and other; the expense sheet breaks down mortgage, living, entertainment, etc.; the investment sheet displays asset allocation and return curves; the overview sheet features a key indicator dashboard and conditional formatting.

events.name: Enter data and generate visual charts
events.description: At 20:50, the organized data was entered item by item, and formulas and conditional formatting were used to generate income-expense comparison bar charts, portfolio growth curves, monthly cash flow waterfall charts, etc., visually presenting the year's financial changes.

events.description: At 21:30, I used red to highlight the cumulative loss from the coffee shop side business (about 20,000 yuan) in the dashboard, green to highlight the overall growth rate of the investment portfolio (about 18%), and an arrow to indicate that the distance to the one-million target was still about 75,000 yuan.

events.name: Generate a gap analysis report and a written summary
events.description: At 21:50, on the overview page, compare the actual portfolio values against the year-start million-yuan target item by item, calculate the gap percentage (completion rate 92.5%), and generate variance analysis notes and preliminary improvement ideas.

events.name: Pull up the annual financial statements and check them item by item
events.description: 22:10 Opened the complete annual financial statements on the encrypted hard drive, checked the year's revenue, expenses, investment returns, and side-business profit/loss item by item, compared them with the savings rate (30%) and portfolio targets set at the beginning of the year, and recorded deviations: savings rate only reached 25%, and side-business trial-and-error costs exceeded the budget by 3%.

events.name: Set specific financial goals for 2026
events.description: At 22:40, based on the review results, I set core goals for 2026 in an Excel sheet: increase the proportion of passive income from 15% to 25%, control side-business trial-and-error costs to no more than 5% of annual income, set the total investment stop-loss line at -8% of total assets, and write down initial asset allocation adjustment directions.

events.name: Refining the investment portfolio adjustment plan and strategy
events.description: Further refinement at 23:00: reallocated the proportions of stocks, funds, and fixed income to 50:30:20, designed quarterly rebalancing trigger rules (adjust when deviation exceeds 5%), compiled the execution process for stop-loss line triggers, and listed specific steps to expand passive income (adding high-dividend stocks, considering REITs, etc.).

events.name: Organize financial planning documents and save them encrypted.
events.description: At 23:10, organized the goals, strategies, and plans into a formal PDF "2026 Personal Financial Planning". At the end of the document, wrote a reminder: "In 2026, I need to increase the proportion of passive income and control the trial-and-error cost of side hustles." Used encryption software to set a strong password and saved it to the "Financial Planning" folder on the encrypted hard drive. After finishing, he felt much clearer about his future path. His mother called to ask how he was doing, and he completed the final save while on the phone.

After the race, he exchanged training insights with Gao Yunfei and the new friends, and a spark of systematic preparation for a half marathon grew in his mind. In the afternoon, while sorting out his New Year goals at Shen Xinyi's café, stress quietly crept in, but he still felt full of forward momentum. In the evening, after a video call with his father, he went to bed early to save energy for the post-holiday work.

Along the way, he kept pace with Gao Yunfei, and at the finish line got to know fellow runners Liu Yang, Chen Tao, and others, exchanging New Year greetings and discussing their running goals.

events.name: Exchange training plans with running buddies and schedule a joint training session.

The four added each other on WeChat and agreed to practice together every Saturday at Yuelu Mountain, with Gao Yunfei volunteering to be responsible for route planning.

events.description: At 3 p.m., Feng Haoran went to his usual cafe run by Shen Xinyi, ordered an Ethiopian pour-over coffee, and sat by the window writing down New Year's goals: being promoted to investment director, completing a half marathon, starting CFA exam preparation and MBA studies. Watching people come and go outside, he felt both inspired and aware of the enormity of the tasks, and drew an upward arrow at the edge of his notebook to encourage himself.

His father reminded him to keep warm in winter, and his mother urged him to eat meals on time. After hanging up, Feng Haoran felt the warmth of family love, washed up, and went to bed to recharge for the next day's work.

2025-01.daily_overview: On Saturday morning, Feng Haoran and Gao Yunfei officially started their first half-marathon training session. They completed a 15-kilometer long-distance run on Yuelu Mountain, and with good teamwork, Feng Haoran's cardiorespiratory response was positive. After the training, they agreed on a weekly schedule, marking running's transition from a hobby to systematic training. In the afternoon, Feng Haoran handled chores at home and relaxed. In the evening, he watched instructional videos to learn running form optimization. The smooth first session filled him with confidence for the half marathon.

events.name: Morning preparation and gathering
events.description: At 5:30 a.m., Feng Haoran woke up to his alarm. After a quick wash, he put on quick-dry clothing, compression pants, and ASICS running shoes, checked the battery of his sports watch, and carried a small bottle of water and energy gel. He walked 15 minutes to the East Gate of Yuelu Mountain. Gao Yunfei had arrived 5 minutes early. The two exchanged brief greetings and checked the route. Elderly people exercising nearby cast approving glances.

events.name: 15 km Yuelu Mountain long-distance training
events.description: At exactly 6:15, the two started running along the planned route: entering from the East Gate, turning onto Lushan South Road to Aiwan Pavilion, going through the Yuelu Mountain trails to the sightseeing cable car station, then turning back. They maintained a pace of 5:30/km, and stopped at the 8 km mark for 90 seconds to drink water. Feng Haoran kept an eye on his breathing rhythm throughout, controlling his heart rate at 140-155 bpm. He felt a bit strained on the uphill sections but overall felt good, finishing the workout in 2 hours and 15 minutes. Along the way, they saw the sunrise dye the sky red, and Gao Yunfei said, "This is a runner's privilege."

events.name: Post-workout stretching and review
events.description: At 8:30, the two returned to East Gate Square and did 15 minutes of static stretching on a bench, focusing on relaxing the quadriceps and calves. During the stretching, Gao Yunfei praised Feng Haoran for his good long-distance endurance. Feng Haoran reported no knee discomfort, but his right hip was slightly tight. The two reviewed the data on their sports watches, agreed that the current pace was suitable as a half-marathon base training, and arranged to increase to 16 kilometers next week.

events.name: Agree on the weekly training schedule
events.description: After stretching, the two sat on a stone bench and opened phone memos to jointly draft a training plan: Tuesday morning tempo run of 8-10 km (Feng Haoran to complete alone), Thursday early morning tempo run of 8-10 km (joint training), Saturday morning long run of 16-20 km progressive (joint training). Feng Haoran took the initiative to be responsible for sending weekly training reminders. Gao Yunfei joked that this was "using an investor's risk-control mindset to manage training."

events.name: Afternoon household chores and relaxation.
events.description: Feng Haoran spent the whole afternoon at his residence: he first sorted the dirty clothes accumulated over the past few days and ran the washing machine to clean his running clothes; then he wiped the mud off his running shoes and hung them out to dry. After that, he played some soft music, half-reclined on the sofa, and read National Geographic magazine to learn about self-driving trips on the Sichuan-Tibet Highway, and took a short 40-minute nap to recover. When he woke up, he received a dinner invitation from Peng Yuqing for the weekend, and he replied, "Next week, I'm too tired today."

2025-01.daily_overview: On Sunday morning, Feng Haoran went for a short recovery run. Later, the core of the day was the afternoon stamp collection exchange meeting. He carefully prepared his exhibits, received praise from senior collectors at the tea room, and agreed with a collector from Changde to exchange stamps by mail. In the evening, he organized his collection and sent a summary of the exchange to his collector friend Luo Zhenyu, who is far away in Shenzhen. His hobby life was fulfilling and tasteful. A small incident was that his beloved tweezers accidentally fell to the floor and broke, but he quickly continued sorting with a spare pair.

events.name: Early morning recovery jog
events.description: To promote muscle recovery from yesterday's training, Feng Haoran got up at 7 o'clock and jogged 5 kilometers near home, deliberately slowing the pace to 6 minutes 30 seconds per kilometer, with his heart rate below 135 throughout. After the run, he had breakfast at the rice noodle roll shop downstairs with a cup of unsweetened soy milk. Back home, he took a hot shower and felt his thigh soreness greatly relieved.

events.name: Prepare stamp collection exhibits and set off.
events.description: At 10 a.m., Feng Haoran opened the display cabinet and took out the 1994 Yangtze River Three Gorges stamp album. He carefully inspected the perforations and gum on each stamp with tweezers, selected 4 complete set stamps in full condition, placed them in positioning bags, and handwrote explanatory labels noting the issuance background. At 12 noon, he changed into a gray sweater, took the stamp album and took a taxi to the reserved 'Qinghe Tea House' in Tianxin District. Traffic was smooth along the way, arriving in about 25 minutes.

events.name: Attend a stamp collecting circle exchange event
events.description: At 2 p.m., the exchange gathering began in a private tearoom, with about 15 collector friends seated around a long table. Feng Haoran presented third, introducing his experience collecting Yangtze River Three Gorges stamps. Senior collector Lao Zhou commented that the condition of his set reached "very fine", and suggested watching for the matching 1994-18 Three Gorges Dam Closure commemorative postal card set. Feng Haoran took careful notes and also had the chance to admire rare stamps such as the Qing Dynasty Red Revenue and Republic of China Junk issues, which was an eye-opener.

events.name: Had an in-depth exchange with a Changde collector friend and made a mutual appointment.
events.description: During the free exchange session, an old collector friend from Changde, Hunan, Mr. Liu, took the initiative to sit next to Feng Haoran. The two had a lively discussion on stamp authentication techniques. Mr. Liu showed his collection of a special album on the Changde Anti-Japanese War, and Feng Haoran praised its high historical value. They exchanged mailing addresses, agreed to send each other local specialty stamps every month, and left phone numbers for future contact. During the conversation, Feng Haoran accidentally knocked a pair of tweezers off the table. When he picked them up, he found the tip bent, so he had to switch to the spare tweezers in his bag.

events.name: Returning home to organize and sharing remotely.
events.description: At around 6 p.m., the exchange meeting ended, and Feng Haoran took a taxi back home in Yuelu District. He classified the business cards he obtained from collector friends by region and put them into the card holder, then carefully organized the stamp album with spare tweezers before putting it back in the collection cabinet, and checked the logistics information for the new tweezers on his phone. After dinner, he sent photos and thoughts from today's exchange meeting via WeChat to his collector friend Luo Zhenyu in Shenzhen. Luo Zhenyu replied that he might come to Changsha to visit an exhibition in March, and the two agreed to meet then. Feng Haoran also used his phone to order a new pair of German tweezers online, expected to arrive in two days.

2025-01.daily_overview: Start of the workweek on Monday. In the morning, Feng Haoran focused on handling client emails and the weekly investment report, and attended compliance training in the afternoon. After work, due to continuous rain, he chose to try his first yoga stretching course at home, and completed a core training session before bed. In the evening, he contacted his classmate in Shenzhen to confirm the gathering arrangements during the summit, and mailed a spare key to his running buddy Gao Yunfei in advance in case it rained and he forgot to close the window while on a business trip. The occasional rainy day disrupted his morning running plan, but he filled the gap with indoor exercise.

events.name: Commute and morning non-run day schedule
events.description: Rain canceled the outdoor morning run. Feng Haoran got up at 6:50 and did 15 minutes of core training at home (plank, supine leg raises). At 8, he put on leather shoes and a black trench coat, walked to the metro station with an umbrella, took Line 2 to Furong Middle Road Station, and on the way checked Bloomberg's global market morning briefing on his phone; gold prices had fallen slightly.

events.name: Handle client emails and write weekly report
events.description: At 9 a.m., Feng Haoran opened Outlook and found an inquiry from client Huang Siqi about reducing holdings in tech stocks. He immediately prepared data and used WeChat voice messages to explain the valuation logic to Huang Siqi, suggesting a gradual reduction in batches. He then spent 1.5 hours writing the 'High-End Client Investment Weekly Report,' covering market dynamics of A-shares, H-shares, and U.S. stocks, and attaching personalized suggestions for each VIP client, before sending it to Qian Yongqiang for review. During the review and revision, Qian Yongqiang asked him to add a chart, and he finished it before lunch.

events.name: Attend Company Compliance Training
events.description: At 2 p.m., all investment advisors of Huatai Securities attended the quarterly compliance training, which was conducted online simultaneously. The training focused on interpreting the revisions to the 2025 Interim Provisions on Securities Investment Advisory Business. Feng Haoran noted down the changes in prohibited clauses and completed the in-class test via the App. After the training, he separately confirmed the boundaries of online promotional language with the compliance officer, who reminded him that recommending stocks on WeChat Moments is being strictly inspected recently.

events.name: First try at indoor yoga in the evening
events.description: The rain hadn't stopped in the evening. Feng Haoran remembered that a colleague had recommended yoga for stress relief, so he found the '30-Minute Beginner Flow Yoga' course on the Keep App, laid out a yoga mat in the living room, and followed along. His body was a bit stiff on the first attempt, but the sense of relaxation after finishing made him decide to do yoga twice a week. After showering, he felt his shoulders and neck were comfortable, and decided to use yoga instead of morning runs on rainy days.

events.name: Core training and contacting friends in Shenzhen
events.description: At 8:30 pm, Feng Haoran remembered that he had not finished his core training today, so he did an extra 10 minutes of push-ups and mountain climbers. Then he sent messages on WeChat to Zhang Mingxuan, Wang Lina, and Dong Haoran respectively, telling them he would attend a conference in Shenzhen from January 9 to 11 and asking if they were free to meet. Zhang Mingxuan quickly replied to arrange a dinner on the evening of the 10th; Wang Lina said she was free for coffee on the afternoon of the 11th; Dong Haoran suggested meeting near Tencent. All three expressed anticipation, and Feng Haoran checked his schedule reminders again.

After getting to work, he began preparing a new-energy sector analysis for client Lin Zhihao; in the afternoon, he discussed initial plans with a new client and phoned a trust manager to customize presentation materials for Lin Zhihao. After work, he listened to an investment podcast during his commute. In the evening, while packing his luggage, he found his passport sandwiched in an old book—a false alarm. Before bed, he also made a schedule for his Shenzhen trip, determined not to let either fitness or meetings slide.

events.name: Morning tempo run training
events.description: At exactly 6 in the morning, Feng Haoran got dressed and went out, running an 8-kilometer tempo run along the Lushan South Road - Xiaoxiang Middle Road out-and-back route. Following the advice from a book borrowed from the library, he warmed up with a slow jog for the first 3 kilometers, then maintained a lactate threshold pace of 4:50 per kilometer for the remaining 5 kilometers, with his heart rate between 150 and 160 bpm. After finishing, he stretched for 10 minutes downstairs, feeling in good shape. The neighbor uncle said to him, "Young man, running again today?"

events.name: Prepared new energy investment analysis for client Lin Zhihao.
events.description: At 9 a.m., Feng Haoran began organizing the China-US new energy stock pool. He used the Wind terminal to export financial data of the photovoltaic and lithium battery sectors over the past three years and created a valuation comparison table. He then wrote a briefing of about 2,000 characters titled "Analysis of Investment Opportunities in the New Energy Sector," attached three recommended targets and allocation weight suggestions, and sent it by email to Lin Zhihao. Lin Zhihao quickly replied, "Received. I'll forward it to the company's finance department."

events.name: Preliminary communication with a new client.
events.description: At 3 p.m., director Qian Yongqiang referred a potential client—a Changsha local business owner—who wanted asset preservation consulting. Feng Haoran conducted an initial phone interview with him for about 20 minutes, learned about his capital scale and risk preference, and agreed to meet next week. He created a new client profile in the CRM system, recorded the key points of the initial communication, and set a reminder for next week.

events.name: Listening to an investment podcast during the commute after work.
events.description: While taking the subway after work, Feng Haoran put on his earphones and listened to the latest episode of Crazy Investment Circle about blockchain finance applications. The guest mentioned the trend of combining DeFi with traditional asset management. He thought of the upcoming Shenzhen summit and specifically screenshotted the relevant views and saved them to his phone notes. A nearby passenger glanced at his screen and struck up a conversation: "You're into blockchain too?" They chatted briefly; Feng Haoran learned that the other person worked in IT, and they added each other on WeChat.

events.name: Evening packing for Shenzhen trip and false alarm
events.description: At 9 p.m., Feng Haoran took out a small carry-on suitcase and put in two suits, a casual jacket, a laptop, a charger, and a business card holder. He confirmed that the high-speed rail e-ticket had been sent to his phone, and placed the pre-printed summit schedule into a document folder, then set an alarm for 6 a.m. the next morning. When he checked his personal belongings, he found that his passport was not in its usual place. After rummaging for ten minutes, he finally found it in a copy of 'The Intelligent Investor' on the bookshelf—it turned out he had used it as a bookmark during a road trip and forgotten to take it out. He breathed a sigh of relief, checked the water, electricity, doors, and windows before bed, and also sent a message to Gao Yunfei asking him to keep an eye on the mailbox.

In the afternoon, he handed over the week's affairs with colleagues, and in the evening attended the MBA online admission orientation meeting, gaining an initial understanding of the course plan. When booking the hotel, his credit card limit was insufficient, so he temporarily switched to another card and resolved it. A fulfilling day paved the way for the business trip.

events.name: Morning run and work morning meeting
events.description: Feng Haoran got up at 6, ran an easy 5 km to stay in shape, then went to work as usual. At 9 a.m. there was the department morning meeting. Qian Yongqiang stressed that the team needed to keep a close eye on overseas markets this week. Feng Haoran briefly reported that Zheng Wenbo had been watching over clients on his behalf during his business trip. After the meeting, he handled several urgent emails. One from the compliance department asked him to supplement a customer follow-up questionnaire, so he hurriedly found the materials and filled it out.

events.name: Prepare materials for the Shenzhen summit and book the itinerary.
events.description: At 10:30 in the morning, Feng Haoran began to prepare materials for the meeting: he downloaded and printed the white paper 'Frontiers of Blockchain Applications in Asset Allocation' from the company database, highlighted key data with a highlighter pen; put 40 personal business cards into a dedicated card case. Then he logged into the Ctrip app, booked a second-class seat on the G6013 high-speed train from Changsha South to Shenzhen North on January 9 (departing 11:30, arriving 14:40), and placed an order for two nights at 'Yueju Boutique Hotel' near Shenzhen Bay Science and Technology Park. When paying, his China Merchants Bank card showed insufficient balance, so he switched to his China Construction Bank card and completed the payment successfully. He decided to apply for a credit limit increase after returning from the business trip.

events.name: Hand over this week's client matters with colleagues
events.description: At noon, Feng Haoran had Zheng Wenbo sit down with him in the company break room, took out the customer follow-up form, briefly explained that Lin Zhihao's new energy analysis had been sent and that Huang Siqi might make a sell-off move in the near future, and asked Zheng Wenbo to help answer calls and monitor position changes. Zheng Wenbo readily agreed and joked, "You owe me a meal."

events.name: Handle administrative and financial documents in the afternoon
events.description: After the lunch break, Feng Haoran went to the finance department to apply for an advance of 3,000 yuan for travel expenses for the business trip to Shenzhen. He filled out a loan form and a business trip application form, which were signed by Qian Yongqiang and then handed to the cashier. After that, he organized this month's reimbursement receipts, scanned and uploaded them to the OA system. In the remaining time, he read industry news to reserve topics for the summit discussion. When he came out of the finance department, he overheard two colleagues talking about "year-end bonus might shrink," and felt a slight sinking feeling.

events.name: Attend the MBA online orientation session in the evening
events.description: At 7 p.m., Feng Haoran opened Tencent Meeting to attend the online spring semester enrollment guidance meeting held by the MBA Education Center of a university in Changsha. The program director introduced the curriculum, course selection system, and assessment methods. Feng Haoran noted the start times for Strategic Management and Portfolio Theory, and noticed that courses would be held on weekends with intensive face-to-face sessions, while weekdays would have group discussions. The meeting lasted 1 hour. He added the academic affairs teacher on WeChat and jotted down the list of documents needed for the first class.

2025-01.daily_overview: Feng Haoran set off on a three-day, two-night business trip to Shenzhen. He arrived at noon by high-speed rail and immediately plunged into the main forum of the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area FinTech Summit in the afternoon, learning about cutting-edge applications of blockchain in asset allocation. During the coffee break, he exchanged business cards with industry peers. In the evening, he had his first dinner in Shenzhen with his childhood friend Zhang Mingxuan, talking freely about careers and technology. After returning to the hotel, he still did not forget his core training, using a resistance band to complete 30 minutes of strength exercises, then went out for a 7-kilometer jog along Shenzhen Bay. The itinerary was compact and efficient.

events.name: High-speed rail to Shenzhen.
events.description: At 8 a.m., Feng Haoran took a taxi from home to Changsha South Railway Station. After passing security, he bought coffee and a sandwich for breakfast in the waiting hall. At 11:30, he boarded the G6013 high-speed train on time. His seatmate was a Huawei engineer, and the two chatted about the application of 5G in the financial sector. Feng Haoran asked for his business card. On the train, he browsed a white paper and took a short nap. He arrived at Shenzhen North Station at 14:40. After exiting the station, he took Metro Line 11 directly to Houhai Station, walked to the hotel, checked in, put down his luggage, and changed into a suit.

events.name: Attended the main forum of the FinTech Summit
events.description: At 3 p.m., Feng Haoran arrived at the Shenzhen Convention and Exhibition Center to check in and receive his conference badge and materials bag. At the main forum, experts from the Hong Kong Stock Exchange, WeBank, and Ant Chain spoke in turn. He listened attentively, paying special attention to the application of blockchain in asset securitization and robo-advisor architecture. During the 30-minute tea break, he proactively exchanged business cards with several nearby attendees from different institutions, including a Shenzhen private equity researcher and a Hangzhou fintech product manager, the latter expressing great interest in the practical implementation of robo-advisors.

events.name: First dinner in Shenzhen with childhood friend Zhang Mingxuan
events.description: The forum ended at 5:30 p.m. As agreed, Feng Haoran met his childhood friend Zhang Mingxuan at "Nonggengji", a Hunan restaurant in MixC Shenzhen Bay. They ordered home-style dishes such as chopped pepper fish head and stir-fried yellow beef with small peppers, chatting while eating. Zhang Mingxuan shared his experience as a product manager at Tencent, mentioning the mindset of using data to drive iterative product development; Feng Haoran talked about the digitalization challenges facing the traditional financial industry. Zhang Mingxuan suggested that he could try developing a personal investment portfolio visualization tool, which inspired Feng Haoran. The meal lasted nearly two hours. When the bill came, Zhang Mingxuan insisted on paying, saying, "Since you're in Shenzhen, it's my treat."

events.name: Hotel core training and night running
events.description: After saying goodbye to Zhang Mingxuan, Feng Haoran returned to the hotel at nearly 8 o'clock. Not wanting to interrupt his training routine, he did 20 minutes of core strength training in the room using a resistance band (plank variations, clamshells, supine alternating leg raises), sweating profusely. Then he changed into running shoes and jogged 7 kilometers along the running track of Shenzhen Bay Park. The sea breeze brushed his face, and Hong Kong's lights twinkled across the water. As he ran, he thought about Zhang Mingxuan's advice, feeling stirred. After finishing the run, he felt completely relaxed. He returned to the hotel, showered, and immediately rested.

2025-01.daily_overview: On the second day of the summit, Feng Haoran attended the intelligent investment advisory sub-forum in the morning, gaining deep insights into cases combining blockchain and investment advisory. During the lunch break, he connected with several practitioners and took time to book his annual physical exam in Changsha. In the afternoon, he visited the fintech achievement expo and tried a digital human investment advisory product. Because he didn't sleep well in an unfamiliar bed, he was not energetic during the day, but still insisted on a 6 km morning run. In the evening, he had a small gathering with college classmate Zhao Tianyu in Shenzhen, exchanging views on careers, and returned to the hotel at 10 p.m.

events.name: Morning run and breakfast.
events.description: At 6:30 in the morning, Feng Haoran felt groggy after getting up, but he still changed into sportswear and jogged 6 kilometers along the greenway around the hotel. After returning to the hotel, he enjoyed a buffet breakfast, choosing eggs, fruit, and oatmeal porridge, paired with a cup of black coffee to dispel drowsiness. While checking his phone, he found a WeChat message from his mother, urging him "Don't work too hard while you're away."

events.name: Attend the intelligent investment advisory sub-forum and build connections
events.description: At 9 a.m., Feng Haoran entered the sub-forum “Intelligent Investment Advisory and Blockchain Practice.” On stage, representatives of China Merchants Securities and Harvest Fund shared an intelligent investment advisory system based on a consortium blockchain. Feng Haoran asked how to resolve the contradiction between client privacy and putting data on the blockchain, and received a detailed answer. During the noon break after the session, he proactively approached a product manager from Ping An Technology and a colleague from Huatai Securities' Shenzhen branch. They chatted while having a light meal in the rest area, added each other on WeChat, and agreed to share materials after returning to Changsha. The Ping An manager mentioned they were recruiting, and Feng Haoran was a little tempted.

events.name: Phone appointment for annual physical examination
events.description: At 1:00 PM, Feng Haoran used his break time to call the Physical Examination Center of Changsha Central Hospital by phone, and made an appointment for the annual personal health checkup at 8:00 AM on January 12 (Sunday). The nurse reminded him to fast for 8 hours before the checkup. He wrote it down in his memo and set a reminder.

events.name: Visit fintech exhibition and experience
events.description: At 2 PM, the exhibition hall opened. Feng Haoran experienced digital human investment advisor demonstrations from several institutions and was deeply impressed by the application of AI natural language processing in asset diagnosis. He lingered at the China Merchants Bank booth the longest, asking in detail about the design logic of the intelligent investment advisor module in its mobile banking 7.0, and collected several brochures to take back for research. Because he hadn't slept well, he was a bit dazed in the afternoon, his legs ached from standing long at the booth, so he returned to the hotel early and lay down for half an hour.

events.name: Dinner with college roommate Zhao Tianyu
events.description: At 7 PM, Feng Haoran met his college roommate Zhao Tianyu, who is now a product manager at Tencent, at a Chaoshan beef hot pot restaurant near the technology park. The two were bunkmates in college and had a deep friendship. Zhao Tianyu shared the fast pace and age anxiety of Shenzhen's internet workplace, while Feng Haoran talked about the difficulty of promotion in traditional finance. After encouraging each other, Zhao Tianyu half-jokingly invited Feng Haoran to consider transitioning to the internet industry. Feng Haoran smiled without saying a word. The hot pot was steaming, and the two didn't leave until ten o'clock.

In the afternoon, after briefly meeting up with Wang Lina and Dong Haoran, he rushed to Shenzhen North Station in the evening to take the high-speed train back to Changsha. Unexpectedly, the train was delayed an hour due to a signal failure, and he didn't return to his home in Changsha until late at night. Though tired, he was full of new information and connections, which prompted a brief reflection on his career path.

events.name: Visited Tencent Binhai Tower for in-depth exchanges with Zhang Mingxuan
events.description: At 10 a.m., Feng Haoran went to Tencent Binhai Building as promised. Under Zhang Mingxuan's guidance, he toured the exhibition hall to understand Tencent's layout in areas such as fintech and smart cities. Then the two sat down in an internal café, where Zhang Mingxuan opened his laptop and briefly demonstrated the idea of building a personal investment portfolio dashboard using Excel and Python. Feng Haoran excitedly took photos. Zhang Mingxuan again suggested he learn some programming fundamentals on his own, even just Python data analysis, which would greatly help his investment advisory work. The exchange lasted about 2 hours. At the end, Zhang Mingxuan handed him a copy of "Python for Finance," saying, "Borrow it first."

events.name: Briefly crossed paths with Wang Lina and Dong Haoran.
events.description: At 12:30 noon, Wang Lina and Dong Haoran each hurried from Nanshan Science and Technology Park and Futian to a cha chaan teng near Tencent. The three ordered siu mei rice and chatted for about an hour. Wang Lina works in operations at an e-commerce company in Shenzhen and mentioned the fierce competition in Shenzhen's job market; Dong Haoran had just switched to an AI startup and was full of ambition. Feng Haoran felt a stir seeing his friends' brand-new professional states. Since he needed to get to Shenzhen North Station before 3 p.m., they took a quick group photo and parted. Wang Lina gave Feng Haoran a box of Shenzhen specialty dried lychees.

events.name: High-speed rail return to Changsha, delays and twists
events.description: At 2 p.m., Feng Haoran picked up his luggage from the hotel, checked out, and took the metro to Shenzhen North Station. He had originally planned to take the G6014 high-speed train (departing at 16:00 and arriving at Changsha South at 19:30), but the station announced that the train would be delayed to 17:10 due to a signal failure. In the waiting hall, Feng Haoran bought McDonald's, dealt with a few work emails on his phone, and read a few pages of CFA materials. After departure, he rested with his eyes closed on the train, reviewing the three-day trip and his conversations with friends, his heart stirred. It was not until 9:30 p.m. that he arrived at Changsha South Station, and he took a taxi home at nearly 10 p.m.

events.name: Organize the takeaways from the Shenzhen trip.
events.description: At 10:30 p.m., despite being tired, Feng Haoran still opened his computer and organized the summit materials, business cards, and key points discussed with friends into Evernote. He wrote a few lines of reflections: traditional asset management needs to actively embrace technology, but path dependence is hard to change; social circles are polarizing, and one should be wary of job burnout. These reflections made him anxious but also inspired upward motivation. After organizing, he remembered he had a fasting physical exam the next morning, so he skipped a late-night snack and only drank a glass of water.

2025-01.daily_overview: On Sunday, Feng Haoran got up early and went to the hospital fasting for his annual physical examination. The slightly elevated blood lipids sounded a health alarm, but he didn't take it too seriously for now. Following the doctor's advice, he remembered that he had already downloaded the Boohee Health app, decided to restart food logging, and recorded his first meal. In the afternoon, during a video call with his younger sister, they both noticed that their mother had grown thinner, and agreed to take her for a physical examination during the Spring Festival, which brought the siblings closer emotionally. In the evening, he organized his summit notes and business cards, wrote down his reflections on the conference, and resolved to integrate new technology into his daily work.

events.name: Go to the hospital on an empty stomach to complete a comprehensive physical exam.
events.description: At 7:30 a.m., Feng Haoran drank only a small amount of plain water and rode a shared bicycle to the Physical Examination Center of Changsha Central Hospital. Following the instructions, he completed in order blood draw (complete blood count, liver and kidney function, four lipid panel items), abdominal ultrasound, electrocardiogram, chest X-ray, and urine test. The process went smoothly and ended around 9:00. The nurse told him the report would be ready in three days. He then had congee and eggs at a breakfast shop near the hospital to regain energy.

events.name: The doctor interpreted the medical examination report and provided health advice.
events.description: At 11 a.m., Feng Haoran returned to the hospital and picked up some immediate reports, then entered the doctor's office to hear the interpretation. Dr. Wang pointed to the blood lipid report and noted that total cholesterol was 5.8 mmol/L and low-density lipoprotein was 3.6 mmol/L, both slightly above normal. He diagnosed mild hyperlipidemia and advised reducing high-fat foods, increasing aerobic exercise, and monitoring body weight. Feng Haoran agreed verbally, but privately thought that his youth made it of no concern. The doctor suggested that he could use his phone to record his diet, which would help control intake. Feng Haoran remembered that he had previously downloaded the “Mint Health” App but had not kept using it. He decided to restart diet recording from today and recorded the porridge and eggs from breakfast on the spot.

events.name: In the afternoon, organized summit materials and business cards
events.description: At 2 p.m., Feng Haoran sat at his desk, sorted the business cards collected at the summit by organization, entered them into his phone's contacts, and added notes. Then he reread the white paper and his notes, and wrote a Shenzhen Fintech Summit Participation Summary, highlighting three takeaways: the localized application of robo-advisory, the potential of blockchain in cross-border assets, and the inspiration of internet product thinking for advisory services. Finally, he decided to add Zhang Mingxuan's suggestion about building a personal investment portfolio dashboard to his next-step study plan, and placed Python Financial Big Data Analysis in a prominent spot on his desk.

events.name: Video call with younger sister Feng Xinran.
events.description: At 7 p.m., Feng Haoran initiated a WeChat video call to his younger sister Feng Xinran in Shanghai. They talked about their recent lives and pre-holiday arrangements. Feng Haoran suggested that this Spring Festival the family return to Wuhan together on the 29th of the 12th lunar month (January 28), and Feng Xinran agreed. 2025-10.daily_overview: On Thursday, Feng Haoran achieved an important creative milestone: he devoted himself to writing and completed the first draft of his first investment column. events.name: Wrote the first draft of the column.
events.description: After getting up at 7 a.m. for a morning run, he began writing his first column at 8:30 sharp in his home study, focusing intently. Based on the materials collected the previous day, he used leading enterprises in Hunan's advanced manufacturing industry as the entry point, analyzing from the perspectives of company history, core competitiveness, financial performance, and future outlook, while incorporating his own investment views. The writing process lasted until 7 p.m., with two brief breaks in between, and finally completed a draft of about 2,000 words, saved as a Word document.

Finally, he took a group photo with the professor and classmates to celebrate the completion of the course.

Feng Haoran used a 35mm lens to capture hurried pedestrians and flowing traffic trails, and tried light-painting effects with a slow shutter speed. A brief shower passed by during the shoot, but they continued under umbrellas, and the reflections added a sense of story to the frames.

events.name: A heartfelt conversation during street photography.
events.description: During a break in the shoot, the two sat by the window of a roadside convenience store. Feng Haoran, for the first time, confided to Xu Jianing about the client complaints caused by recent work mistakes, the frustration of having his paper rejected, and the cervical spine discomfort from long hours of desk work. Xu Jianing also shared the bottlenecks she encountered in her design projects. The two listened to and encouraged each other, surrounded by the camera and the night. Feng Haoran felt the heavy pressure truly shared, and his spirits lifted.

events.name: Finishing street photography and returning home.

Feng Haoran used a ride-hailing app to call a car back to his home in Yuelu District, and went straight to wash up and rest, exhausted. Before sleeping, he realized how helpful this kind of sharing was for his mental health, and decided to more actively maintain such deep social connections in the future.

2025-03.daily_overview: On Tuesday, Feng Haoran took sick leave due to cervical spine issues, and the day revolved around health management. In the morning, he was diagnosed with cervical muscle strain and loss of cervical curvature, and began systematic treatment. In the afternoon, he collaborated remotely to complete the MBA defense PPT. In the evening, after receiving a concerned call from his mother, he studied as usual, but incorporated rehabilitation yoga and adjusted his daily routine. From then on, health became a non-negotiable part of his schedule.

events.name: Initial consultation at the Rehabilitation Department of Xiangya Third Hospital.
events.description: At 8:30 a.m., Feng Haoran arrived at the Rehabilitation Department of the Third Xiangya Hospital in Yuelu District. He described to the doctor his symptoms of persistent neck stiffness, limited rotation, and numbness in his hands during sleep. After palpating his neck, the doctor arranged for a cervical spine X-ray. An hour later, the results came back, diagnosing cervical muscle strain and mild loss of physiological curvature of the cervical spine. The doctor prescribed physical therapy: traction, hot compress, and manual massage twice a week, and emphasized the importance of correcting sitting posture, using an ergonomic pillow, and getting up to move every hour.

events.name: Schedule a series of physical therapy appointments
events.description: After the consultation, Feng Haoran booked three physical therapy sessions at the treatment appointment window: March 20, 24, and 27, each 40 minutes. He also bought an ergonomic memory foam pillow recommended by the hospital, planning to start using it tonight.

events.name: Mother's caring phone call
events.description: At 7 p.m., his mother Li Xiuying called to ask about his health. Feng Haoran told her that his cervical spine problem had been diagnosed and he had started treatment. His mother urged him to stay up less late and keep warm.

events.name: Completed MBA defense PPT through remote collaboration
events.description: Returned home at 1 p.m. Feng Haoran, based on the improvement directions discussed with group members on March 15, opened the shared document in his study and spent 3 hours reorganizing the logical framework of the case analysis. He adjusted the data presentation caliber, added the market background of turning points, and optimized the visual charts. He exchanged opinions with group members in real time through a WeChat group, and finally completed the version update and sent it to everyone for review.

events.name: Financial Ratio Analysis Study
events.description: At 5 PM, after a short rest, Feng Haoran began studying for the CFA, moving into the financial ratio analysis module. He focused on solvency ratios (current ratio, quick ratio, interest coverage ratio) and operational capability ratios (accounts receivable turnover, inventory turnover, total asset turnover). He derived each formula step by step, performed practical calculations using the annual report of a listed company, completed the corresponding practice questions, and annotated the easily confused EBIT values in the interest coverage ratio calculation.

events.name: Evening shoulder and neck yoga.
events.description: At 8 p.m., Feng Haoran spread out his newly bought yoga mat in the living room and followed a shoulder-and-neck relaxation sequence video on a mobile app for 30 minutes. He focused on stretching his trapezius and sternocleidomastoid muscles, and tried chin tucks and scapular stability exercises. After practice, he felt his neck was temporarily relaxed, but it was not a permanent cure.

events.name: Late-night REITs portfolio simulation and discussion preparation
events.description: At 10 p.m., Feng Haoran reviewed the key points of his REITs investments since the beginning of the month. He imported historical data into Excel and simulated building a portfolio containing multiple categories of REITs. He calculated expected annualized returns and volatility, and tried several ways to optimize allocation weights. Then he opened PowerPoint and began organizing his REITs investment cases to create sharing content for the March 20 online seminar, focusing on the underlying asset screening logic and risk-return characteristics. He worked until 12:30 a.m., his neck ached again. He got up to stretch and applied a hot compress.

2025-03.daily_overview: On Wednesday, Feng Haoran resumed brisk walking with his running buddy in the morning and discussed next week's jogging. During work, he explained the REITs plan to an important client over the phone and received positive feedback. In the evening, he continued his Japanese learning plan and completed home neck exercises, making progress in both recovery and self-improvement.

events.name: Morning brisk walk and slow jog discussion
events.description: At 7:30 in the morning, Feng Haoran and Gao Yunfei did a 40-minute brisk walk with stretching on Lushan South Road. He recorded his heart rate data and found it was more stable than last week, with an average heart rate of 125 bpm and no heavy feeling in his legs. Gao Yunfei also said the pacing was well coordinated. The two discussed trying a short-distance jog next week, and Feng Haoran mentioned that he had already obtained the doctor's permission.

events.name: Explain the REITs plan to the client
events.description: At 2 p.m., Feng Haoran used the landline in his office to reach client Lin Zhihao, and spent 20 minutes explaining the core framework of the REITs comprehensive plan: asset diversification logic, allocation ratio, and expected annualized return of 6.5%. Lin Zhihao expressed concerns about liquidity, and Feng Haoran explained the periodic open redemption mechanism of some REITs products, and noted Lin Zhihao's suggestion to adjust the investment horizon to 1-3 years. The call ended in an atmosphere of mutual trust.

events.name: Japanese study and neck exercises
events.description: At 8 PM, Feng Haoran continued his 30-minute Japanese study at home, reviewing the first five rows of kana, learning three new rows, and trying to read simple words aloud. After studying, he did a complete set of family neck exercises: chin tucks, elastic band resistance lateral flexion, and wall angels, totaling 15 minutes. He felt the deep muscles gradually gaining strength.

start_state.mood: Refreshed, looking forward to morning exercise.

2025-03.daily_overview: On Thursday, Feng Haoran finalized the REITs plan based on client feedback and sent it out, earning praise from his supervisor. After work, he completed his last physical therapy session, and his cervical spine mobility had greatly improved. In the evening, he followed a shoulder and neck relaxation sequence at home, marking a functional end to the rehabilitation phase.

events.name: Fine-tune and finalize the investment plan
events.description: At 9 a.m., based on Lin Zhihao's feedback, Feng Haoran adjusted the asset allocation in the proposal at the office, raising the allocation of some highly liquid assets from 15% to 20%, and added risk control clauses. He carefully checked the final version to ensure all data were consistent. The neck discomfort caused by consecutive overtime had worsened, so he applied a hot compress during the lunch break.

events.name: Verbal praise from supervisor
events.description: At 5 p.m., Qian Yongqiang passed by Feng Haoran's desk, praised his recent good client feedback, and encouraged him to continue studying REITs business. Feng Haoran was greatly encouraged.

events.name: Send the final plan and explain
events.description: At 4 p.m., Feng Haoran sent the finalized comprehensive REITs investment plan to Lin Zhihao via encrypted email. Then he made a WeChat voice call and spent 10 minutes explaining the logic, expected returns, and risk control measures of the plan to ensure Lin Zhihao fully understood. Lin Zhihao expressed satisfaction and planned to execute after observing the market the next day. Feng Haoran breathed a sigh of relief after hanging up.

events.name: Third physical therapy and evaluation
events.description: At 6 p.m. after work, Feng Haoran went to Xiangya Third Hospital for his last physical therapy session. The therapist focused on consolidating the effects and functional training. After evaluation, his cervical spine mobility improved by about 60% compared to the initial visit, and the pain index dropped from 6 to 2. The therapist suggested a one-month outpatient follow-up and emphasized maintaining good posture and continuing home exercises. Feng Haoran noted each suggestion in his phone memo.

events.name: Evening shoulder and neck relaxation routine
events.description: After returning home at 8 p.m., Feng Haoran followed a 45-minute shoulder and neck relaxation sequence on his phone app in the living room, including neck rotations, side stretches, shoulder circles, and other movements, coordinated with deep breathing. After the practice, he felt his cervical spine and shoulders were obviously relaxed, and the soreness almost disappeared. He decided to stick to this complete sequence 2-3 times a week in the future.

start_state.mood: Prepared to complete the work phase tasks

end_state.location: Bedroom at home in Changsha.
end_state.mood: Relieved; the cervical spine has improved significantly, and my professional sense of achievement is recovering.

2025-03.daily_overview: On Friday, Feng Haoran used his lunch break to check his car in preparation for a road trip. During market volatility, his REITs plan withstood the test. A client thanked him and added funds, partially restoring his professional reputation. Although working overtime to handle formalities worsened his neck stiffness and pain, he chose hot compress and rest in the evening, and decided not to sacrifice recovery time for overtime anymore.

events.name: Comprehensive vehicle inspection during lunch break.
events.description: At 12:30 noon, Feng Haoran used his lunch break to drive his Volkswagen SUV to a chain car maintenance shop near Lushan South Road for a comprehensive inspection: tire pressure and wear, brake pad thickness, oil level, coolant, and lighting system. The workers topped up the windshield washer fluid and antifreeze; everything was normal. He paid 280 yuan for the inspection fee and received a safety inspection report, giving himself peace of mind for the self-driving trip to Western Hunan.

events.name: REITs plan performs steadily amid market volatility
events.description: At 2 PM, the A-share market suddenly fell, but Lin Zhihao's REITs portfolio fell significantly less than the broader market due to diversified underlying assets. Lin Zhihao proactively called, thanked Feng Haoran for his strategy, praised his risk control ability, and added 500,000 yuan to the entrusted management. After Feng Haoran hung up, most of the frustration that had weighed on him for days dissipated.

events.name: Working overtime to process procedures for additional funds
events.description: After 6 p.m., Feng Haoran worked with the customer service department to handle the account opening and contract signing procedures for the additional 500,000 yuan from Lin Zhihao. He did not leave the company until 8 p.m., and his cervical spine became stiff and painful again from prolonged sitting. For the first time, he realized that sacrificing recovery time for work was not worth it.

start_state.mood: Slightly tired, but looking forward to market validation

end_state.location: Bedroom at home in Changsha.
end_state.mood: A sense of achievement coexists with physical fatigue, and I am determined no longer to sacrifice recovery time for overtime work.
