2025-03.daily_overview: The key themes of Saturday were finalizing the road trip and having an in-depth father-son talk. Feng Haoran video-called a friend in the morning to finalize all the details of the road trip, but in the afternoon, he went to the doctor again for cervical pain. In the evening, he completed a stage wrap-up exercise with his running friends. At night, after sorting stamps, he called his father and reviewed his study progress, drawing a summary conclusion for March.

events.name: Finalized a self-driving trip to Xiangxi with friends.
events.description: At 9 a.m., Feng Haoran had a WeChat video call in his study with friends Peng Yuqing and Dong Haoran. The three spent an hour and a half finalizing the April early road trip through western Hunan: the route is Changsha → Zhangjiajie (two nights) → Fenghuang Ancient Town (one night) → Taohuayuan (one night), a total of 5 days and 4 nights. They settled details such as a daily driving limit of no more than 300 km, booking scenic area tickets, and splitting accommodation costs. Feng Haoran was responsible for booking the lodging.

events.name: Make a checklist of supplies for the road trip
events.description: After the video conference, Feng Haoran opened Excel to make a detailed supplies list, including personal clothing (waterproof jacket, hiking shoes), photography equipment (camera, tripod), camping gear (tent, sleeping bag for temporary camping), common medicines (cold medicine, gastrointestinal medicine, band-aids), snacks, power bank, paper maps, etc., and sent the list to the self-driving tour WeChat group, reminding the other two to prepare separately.

events.name: Visited the doctor again due to cervical spine discomfort.
events.description: At 2 p.m., Feng Haoran felt a sudden worsening of soreness and stiffness in his cervical spine. Worried about recurrence, he went to the outpatient department of Xiangya Third Hospital again. After examination, the doctor believed it was caused by recent fatigue and repeated posture issues, but his condition had not worsened. The doctor advised him to reduce continuous screen time and rest flat on his back more. Feng Haoran got some topical analgesic patches and applied them after returning home.

events.name: Brisk walking exercise phase summary.
events.description: At 5 PM, Feng Haoran and Gao Yunfei did the week's final session of brisk walking combined with stretching on Lushan South Road. He recorded that his heart rate was stable and he had not experienced any discomfort for two weeks. Gao Yunfei also thought the adjusted plan was effective. The two discussed starting recovery jogging next week, initially planning alternating 5 minutes of brisk walking and 3 minutes of jogging.

events.name: Organize stamps and exchange with collectors
events.description: At 9 p.m., Feng Haoran dug out the stamps he had collected recently, took photos and sent them to the collecting group. He discussed the value of a set of Republic of China stamps with Luo Zhenyu, who suggested keeping an eye on the July stamp exhibition in Shanghai.

events.name: Video call with father.
events.description: At 7 p.m., Feng Haoran had a nearly one-hour WeChat video call with his father, Feng Jianguo. He shared the month's work setbacks, lessons from the MBA defense, and the process of recovering the REITs proposal. His father, drawing on his experience as someone who had been through it, encouraged him to stay calm and asked about his mother's recovery. Feng Haoran felt a strong sense of family support and became much more cheerful.

events.name: Monthly learning progress statistics
events.description: After the call, Feng Haoran opened his CFA notes and schedule in his study and tallied his March study progress: the Financial Statement Analysis subject was only two-thirds complete, and important difficult points such as deferred income tax and lease accounting had not yet been mastered. He organized these difficulties into a list and planned to rework his April review plan on Sunday. Finally, he shut down the computer and ended March's study with a hint of regret and expectations for the next month.

2025-03.daily_overview: On Sunday, Feng Haoran mainly completed hotel bookings for the road trip and adjusted his CFA review plan. In the morning, he booked all accommodations on various platforms; in the afternoon, after a video discussion with camping partners about future plans, he made a tight study schedule for April targeting weak areas. During the afternoon break, he also went to a café to relax. Although the rain made outdoor activities inconvenient, his time at home was simple yet efficient.

events.name: Book all accommodation for the road trip.
events.description: At 9 a.m., Feng Haoran opened Meituan and Ctrip. Based on the finalized route, he screened and booked a homestay near Zhangjiajie Forest Park (check-in April 3 for two nights, with parking), a riverside inn in Fenghuang Ancient Town (check-in April 5 for one night, parking available nearby for a fee), and a hotel in Taohuayuan Scenic Area (check-in April 6 for one night). He paid attention to the free cancellation policy, paid a total deposit of 680 yuan, and sent the confirmation screenshots to the self-driving tour group.

events.name: Adjust the CFA review plan for April
events.description: At 2 p.m., Feng Haoran reworked his CFA Level I review plan in his study based on the March study progress and remaining difficult points. He broke down the remaining financial statement analysis content (deferred taxes, lease accounting, and in-depth cash flow statement) into daily tasks, arranged them for the first two weeks of April, and reserved buffer days for overtime. He used different colors to mark priorities, printed it out, and posted it in front of his desk to encourage himself.

events.name: Discussing camping with Xie Yutong.
events.description: At 1 p.m., Xie Yutong sent a video from Shenzhen. The two discussed trying a short camping trip in late April or May, tentatively set around Changsha. Feng Haoran recommended Heimifeng.

events.name: Afternoon café visit
events.description: From 3:30 to 5:00 PM, seeing the rain ease off, Feng Haoran walked to the Starbucks near his home, ordered a hot latte, browsed the newly bought photography book "City Nightlight", and took a few photos of the rainy street scene, relaxing his mind that was slightly tired from making plans.

events.name: Simple stretching and rest at home
events.description: At 5 p.m., Feng Haoran took advantage of the break in the rain to do 20 minutes of yin yoga at home, focusing on stretching his neck, shoulders, and hips. He went to bed early that evening to conserve energy for the last workday of the month.

2025-03.daily_overview: On the last Monday of the month, Feng Haoran worked as usual during the day. In the evening, he returned home for a monthly financial review, investment assessment, and rehabilitation self-evaluation. He made adjustments for overspending, was satisfied with investment growth, felt confident about his cervical spine recovery, and entered April with a clear financial health status.

events.name: Received and confirmed the March salary.
events.description: At 10 a.m., Feng Haoran received a text message on his phone from Huatai Securities about his salary being credited, amounting to 18,500 yuan (after tax). After logging into mobile banking to confirm, he felt somewhat relieved and planned to do a detailed financial allocation in the evening.

events.name: Handling trivial matters on workdays
events.description: During the day, he worked normally, handling account allocations for clients' additional funds, tracking the day's performance of the REITs portfolio, and replying to a few emails when he had time. During lunch break, he casually searched for a few QDII funds on a financial news website and noted down their fee rates and historical returns.

events.name: Monthly income and expense review and budget adjustment
events.description: At 7 p.m., Feng Haoran opened his bookkeeping app and banking app in his study to check March income and expenses line by line. He found that the 1500 yuan spent on photography equipment upgrades and the 800 yuan for Japanese courses both exceeded the budget set at the beginning of the month; the credit card bill totaled 6200 yuan. To ease his cash flow, he applied for three interest-free installments for some large purchases and decided to cut social spending to within 800 yuan in April.

events.name: Fund dollar-cost averaging and portfolio review.
events.description: After financial processing, Feng Haoran logged into the Huatai Securities trading app and executed the monthly automatic investment: transferring 2,000 yuan from his savings account to purchase the CSI 300 Index Fund. He then reviewed his existing portfolio: equity funds were flat, REITs assets had a quarterly yield of 4.2%, and the total market value rose to 825,000 yuan, one step closer to the million-yuan goal. He took a screenshot and saved it with satisfaction.

events.name: Search for overseas REITs regular investment targets
events.description: Using the previously recorded QDII fund list, Feng Haoran carefully compared the fees, historical volatility, and stock index correlation of three overseas REITs funds, preliminarily selected a product tracking the MSCI US REIT index, and planned to further discuss with his supervisor in April before starting a small regular investment.

events.name: Review of March yoga and rehabilitation outcomes
events.description: At 9 PM, Feng Haoran wrote in his diary: This month I practiced yoga a total of 12 times. Combined with physical therapy, the cervical spine pain dropped from 7 to 1, and sleep quality improved significantly. He decided to continue yoga at least twice a week in April and persist with daily neck exercises at home.

events.name: Rehabilitation self-assessment and follow-up plan
events.description: Finally, he stood before the mirror and assessed: his neck moved freely, with no pain when lowering his head or turning it. He decided to maintain the adjusted work and sleep habits, persist with daily exercise, and add the late-April follow-up at Xiangya Third Hospital to his phone reminders. At 11 PM, he turned off the lights and went to sleep, ending March with satisfaction at his health management results.

2025-08.daily_overview: On the last workday of the week, Feng Haoran started with a desk makeover. After evening rock climbing training, he accepted the meditation suggestion, downloaded a meditation app late at night, and took the first step toward emotional management during the high-pressure period.

events.name: Office ergonomic renovation
events.description: Before work, Feng Haoran made a thorough adjustment to his workstation: he raised the monitor base to eye level, adjusted the seat height so his feet rested flat on the floor, placed a supportive cushion behind his lower back, and put a sticky note by his computer reminding him to get up every 45 minutes and move his neck. During the lunch break, he completed the first set of simple office shoulder and neck stretches. Following the doctor's advice, this marked the official start of his cervical spine rehabilitation plan.

events.name: Drove to the climbing gym after work
events.description: After work in the evening, Feng Haoran drove from his home in Yuelu District to the climbing gym near Lushan South Road, carrying his climbing gear bag. Due to the evening rush hour, he encountered some traffic and arrived at 18:45, 15 minutes later than usual.

events.name: Rock climbing training: challenging V2 route
events.description: At the climbing gym, Feng Haoran tackled three V2 routes in turn, completing each after several attempts, taking about 1.5 hours. After training, he returned to the rest area to hydrate and rest, feeling his shoulders and neck move more freely.

events.name: Rock climbing friend Lao Zhou shares meditation experience.
events.description: After training, I met Lao Zhou, a regular, in the rest area. Lao Zhou shared his experience of using 10 minutes of daily mindfulness meditation to cope with competition pressure and improve focus, and suggested Feng Haoran try it during high-pressure periods. Feng Haoran listened carefully and noted down the Headspace meditation app recommended by Lao Zhou in his phone memo.

events.name: Downloaded a meditation app and set up a plan
events.description: After returning home late at night, Feng Haoran searched for and downloaded the Headspace meditation app, browsed the introductory courses for mindfulness practice and the daily 10-minute plan, and got a preliminary understanding of how to use it. He decided to start officially on August 5, set a reminder in his calendar, and added the evening cervical spine rehabilitation exercises to his bedtime routine.

In the afternoon, he tried to recreate a hometown dish but encountered a small setback. Family emotional bonds were strengthened through the warmth of everyday life.

events.name: Video call with parents to provide guidance on healthy eating
events.description: At home in Changsha, he had the weekly routine video call with his parents in Wuhan via WeChat, with his father Feng Jianguo also present. Feng Haoran asked in detail about his parents' recent eating habits and, following the nutritionist's advice, guided his mother step by step to adjust the amount of salt in cooking, reduce pickled foods, and recommended healthy ingredients such as low-sodium soy sauce and flaxseed oil. He also shared his recent work updates in Changsha and his latest street photography works. The call lasted about 45 minutes.

events.name: Try cooking pork rib and lotus root soup and ask mother for advice
events.description: Inspired by his mother's cooking, Feng Haoran decided to try making pork rib and lotus root soup himself, but his heat control was poor and the lotus root pieces were not soft and waxy enough. He called his mother for help via WeChat video, and she remotely guided him on adjustment tips. Although not fully successful, he gained cooking enjoyment and agreed to learn in person next time he goes home.

events.name: Home tidying and stamp organizing
events.description: After the rain stopped in the afternoon, Feng Haoran tidied up his study. He also took out his stamp album to catalog the few special stamps he had recently collected, preparing for the September national stamp exhibition. With a light rain outside the window, he enjoyed a quiet afternoon coffee at home.

events.name: Evening cervical spine rehabilitation exercises and reading
events.description: After completing a set of cervical rehabilitation exercises in the evening, Feng Haoran read a chapter of 'The Art of Asset Allocation' to accumulate material for next week's client investment strategy report. Before bed, did 10 minutes of stretching on the balcony.

events.name: Started systematic half-marathon training.

During the run, the two agreed to have regular systematic training every Wednesday and Sunday morning, with a plan including interval running and core strength exercises. After this training, Feng Haoran mentally organized his thoughts about the makeup exam decision and declining the startup invitation.

events.name: My younger sister sent information about a new media course
events.description: During the lunch break, received a WeChat message from younger sister Feng Xinran in Shanghai, sharing a link to a new media operations course and tentatively asking for her brother's opinion. Feng Haoran was busy with other matters at the time and did not respond immediately, but was slightly surprised by his sister's change in career interest.

events.name: Practice pour-over coffee and video-chat with Shen Xinyi

The two also briefly discussed the renovation progress of the coffee branch.

events.name: Refine cervical spine rehabilitation exercises and record insights
events.description: In the evening, completed the full set of cervical spine rehabilitation exercises in the study, using resistance bands to strengthen neck muscle training. 2025-08.daily_overview: On a workday, Feng Haoran handled routine investment advisor work in the morning. In the afternoon, he finalized with Shen Xinyi the postponement of the coffee branch's opening to November, signed the contract, and had the construction team enter the site. The side-business investment entered the physical startup stage, and his body sent out fatigue signals.

events.name: Download the training log app and set reminders.
events.description: The day after the first week's training, Feng Haoran searched the mobile app store and downloaded a professional training log app to record the pace, heart rate, and distance of each run, and set up two training reminders every Wednesday and Sunday.

events.name: Handle client investment consultations in the morning.
events.description: During a break at work, Feng Haoran replied to emails from 3 clients about A-share market volatility and bond allocation, and gave position adjustment suggestions based on the latest views of the company's research department.

events.name: Sudden neck stiffness at the office, did McKenzie exercises.
events.description: After two hours of continuous data analysis in the office in the afternoon, Feng Haoran felt slight stiffness in his neck. He immediately stood up and did 5 minutes of McKenzie exercises according to the rehabilitation plan. The symptoms were relieved, and he also strengthened his awareness of standing up regularly.

events.name: Negotiate with Shen Xinyi about postponing the opening of the coffee branch store
events.description: In the afternoon, Feng Haoran held final negotiations with the owner Shen Xinyi at Xinyi Pour-Over Coffee Café on Jiefang West Road, Furong District, Changsha. Shen Xinyi explained in detail the importance of long-term planning, including renovation quality, brand reputation, and market pace. After careful consideration, Feng Haoran agreed to postpone the opening of the coffee branch to November and accepted the renovation schedule proposed by Shen Xinyi. The two reached an agreement on follow-up cooperation details. Through making concessions, Feng Haoran realized the value of slow work and meticulous craftsmanship.

events.name: Signed renovation contract and opening postponement agreement
events.description: Afterwards, Feng Haoran and Shen Xinyi officially signed the renovation contract and the opening postponement agreement at a café. The contract specified a renovation period of two months (from August 4 to October 4), quality standards, payment methods, and the responsibilities and obligations of both parties. Feng Haoran, as the investor, paid the first installment of the renovation fee, while Shen Xinyi, as the operator, promised to supervise the construction progress. The two parties also had an initial discussion on the marketing warm-up plan for the November opening.

events.name: The construction team moved into the branch store premises.
events.description: After signing the contract, the decoration construction team contacted by Shen Xinyi officially moved into the coffee branch store located in Furong District. The team leader, together with Feng Haoran and Shen Xinyi, conducted an on-site survey to confirm key construction details such as the water and electricity layout, wall renovation, and bar counter position. The construction team then began setting up temporary barriers and moving decoration materials, preparing for the official construction the next day. Feng Haoran took original photos of the store on site for documentation.

events.name: Evening cervical spine rehabilitation and meditation study
events.description: Before bed, Feng Haoran completed cervical spine rehabilitation exercises and opened the Headspace app to preview tomorrow's introductory meditation course, ensuring he could get started quickly.

events.name: Late-night heart-to-heart talk with his father, fully enlightened.
events.description: In the evening, the doctor announced during ward rounds that his mother could be discharged next week. Feng Haoran and his father went to the hospital rooftop after 10 o'clock for a long talk. The father said earnestly, "Haoran, health and family come first; making money and career are secondary. You used to always advise me to take care of my health, but you didn't take it seriously yourself. This time your mother got sick, and my blood pressure went up. Don't you see?" Feng Haoran, for the first time, deeply reflected on his past neglect of the family's health advice. He hugged his father and silently wept, solemnly promising to regularly take his parents for check-ups and adjust his lifestyle from now on. The father and son talked until nearly 11 p.m., and their relationship evolved from career mentorship to a life alliance.

He sat by the bedside holding her hand, softly saying that after the discharge procedures tomorrow, he would go back to Changsha for work, and urged her to strictly follow the diet plan. Mother smiled and nodded, praising him for being a real man these past few days. Feng Haoran quietly used his phone to take a photo of the mother-and-son portrait on the bedside cabinet (taken with his Polaroid), and decided to bring it back to Changsha and put it on his office desk.

2025-05.daily_overview: During the Dragon Boat Festival holiday, Feng Haoran got up early for a 5 km morning run, then drove with Xie Yutong and Peng Yuqing to Mount Heng in Nanyue. They set up camp together, went on a light hike to enjoy the scenery, and had deep conversations around the campfire at night. Their friendship deepened in nature, drawing a warm conclusion to May.

events.name: Morning run 5 kilometers.
events.description: Got up at 6:00, ran 5 km along the usual route from 6:10 to 6:55 (pace 6:28, heart rate steady at 148), stretched thoroughly, went home for a quick wash, and fed the cat.

events.description: At 7:30, Feng Haoran drove from his residential complex to pick up Xie Yutong and Peng Yuqing. With the trunk full of gear, they drove along the Beijing-Hong Kong-Macau Expressway for 2 hours and arrived at Mount Heng Scenic Area at 10:00. After buying tickets, they drove to the mid-mountain parking lot.

events.name: Hauling equipment and setting up the tent
events.description: From 10:30 to 12:00, the three of them divided the work and moved the equipment to the camping area near Zhurong Peak. Feng Haoran was responsible for pitching the main tent and driving in the tent pegs, Xie Yutong helped pull the wind ropes, and Peng Yuqing laid out the moisture-proof mat and inner tent. They successfully set up two tents and sprinkled snake repellent powder around the campsite.

events.name: Camp dinner
events.description: At 17:00, returned to the campsite, cooked instant noodles with a portable stove, heated up the braised dishes and fruit we had brought, and sat on the ground to share the food while playing soft music.

events.name: Night bonfire conversation
events.description: At 19:30, they lit a small campfire on the fireproof mat. The three sat around it. Feng Haoran first shared his recent work stress and promotion goals, Xie Yutong confided her confusion about changing jobs, and Peng Yuqing talked about the bottleneck in her self-media work. They listened to each other and offered advice. The fire was not put out until 11 p.m., then each returned to their tent to rest, and their friendship warmed once again.

Late at night, he wrote and published the concluding article for his column, and in the evening he did rock climbing training.

events.name: Daily customer service

events.name: Updated the balance sheet.
events.description: After the market closed at 3 p.m., Feng Haoran immediately updated his personal balance sheet. Thanks to a slight rebound in A-share and Hong Kong stock funds and continuous fixed-amount savings, his total financial assets hit 925,000 yuan for the first time, only 75,000 short of the million-yuan target set at the beginning of the year. He took a screenshot of the data and marked it as the year-end sprint, while rationally reminding himself to avoid impulsive portfolio adjustments.

events.name: Morning run 6 kilometers.

events.name: Get the coffee shop's operating data
events.description: In the afternoon, Feng Haoran contacted the coffee shop owner Shen Xinyi to obtain the electronic ledger of the coffee shop's operating income and expenses for 2025 (the first month of business), including daily turnover, raw material procurement costs, employee wages, utilities and rent. Then at home he used Excel to organize the data by month into a standardized income-expense detail table.

events.name: Had dinner with parents.
events.description: After work, Feng Haoran went to his parents' new home in Yuelu District, Changsha. His mother, Li Xiuying, cooked his favorite pork rib and lotus root soup and several Hunan dishes. The family was warm and harmonious.

events.name: Walk and chat with mother
events.description: After dinner, Feng Haoran accompanied his mother for a walk on the greenway in the neighborhood. During the walk, his mother mentioned recent changes in his younger sister Feng Xinran's personality, sharing many small anecdotes. Feng Haoran smiled knowingly, and the mother and son chatted as they walked, creating a warm and harmonious atmosphere.

events.name: Video call with my sister
events.description: Back home that night, Feng Haoran proactively initiated a video call on WeChat with his younger sister Feng Xinran, who was far away in Shanghai. Feng Xinran edited the photos of their parents' old home in Wuhan and their current new home in Changsha into a short film titled 'From Jiang'an to Lushan', set to the music 'Jasmine Flower' that their mother loved. After watching it, Feng Haoran's eyes glistened slightly, and he praised his sister for her thoughtfulness. Then, rarely, the siblings said to each other, 'You've been through a lot too,' expressing mutual understanding and support for each other's life pressures, and the call ended in a warm atmosphere.

After the funds arrived, he purchased a full amount of target retirement funds according to the fund ratio he had previously selected, took a screenshot to save the transaction record, and noted in his phone memo: 'Long-term retirement reserve, do not do short-term trading.'

He organized the screenshot of the deposit and the payment voucher, then saved them in the tax folder on his personal computer for claiming special additional deductions during the next year's annual individual income tax settlement.

events.name: Updated financial dashboard.

At the same time, he updated the asset allocation ratios to ensure liabilities and investment data were synchronized.

events.name: Organize the debt list.

His sleep time was consistent with the new habit.

events.name: Long-distance run 15 km
events.description: At 6 a.m., Feng Haoran completed a 15-kilometer run along the Xiangjiang River greenway in light rain, with a pace of 6:20/km. After the run, he stretched thoroughly and used a massage gun. This month's running mileage stood at 112 kilometers.

events.name: Monthly personal summary
events.description: In the morning, Feng Haoran was at home reviewing his November life, including column reading volume, running records, social gains, etc., and simply listed achievements and shortcomings in his notebook. He opened the bookkeeping app and found that after deducting the 12,000 yuan pension contribution made on November 28 (fully subscribed to a fund), the book value of financial assets was 918,000 yuan, still 82,000 yuan short of the million-yuan goal, but the actual total assets (including the pension account) reached 930,000 yuan. He highlighted the year-end sprint plan in red on his financial dashboard and noted the total asset basis. After the summary, Feng Haoran arranged with Gao Yunfei via WeChat to jointly challenge a half marathon (21.1 kilometers) in mid-December, and planned to proceed steadily according to the training schedule.

events.name: Rock climbing training camp
events.description: From 2 to 4 p.m., Feng Haoran attended the Sunday rock climbing training camp. Under the coach's guidance, he steadily completed two V3 routes, executed dynamic techniques perfectly, and officially broke through to 7 pull-ups, bringing a perfect end to his November climbing.

events.name: Check the coffee shop's first-month accounts
events.description: At 5 p.m., Feng Haoran carefully checked the complete first-month operating accounts with the owner Shen Xinyi in the coffee shop he had invested in. After calculating expenses such as rent, labor, and ingredients, he confirmed that the net profit was negative 2,000 yuan. Sitting by the bar, he used his laptop to export the detailed income and expenditure statements, comparing purchase receipts and sales records item by item to ensure the data was accurate.

events.name: Write a reflection journal
events.description: After checking the accounts, Feng Haoran returned to his bedroom at home and took out his diary before bed to write reflections. He noted that the small loss in the first month was expected, but after putting down the pen he still felt a bit disappointed. After staring at the ledger in silence for a moment, he looked through photos of the cafe crowd during the photo exhibition and warm sticky notes on the message wall, realized that brand building takes time, and drew a simple sketch of a steaming cup of coffee in the corner of the page, reminding himself to stay confident.

events.name: Encrypted backup of financial data
events.description: At 8 PM, Feng Haoran placed the Excel file containing all financial data, the original transaction PDF, and the explanation document into one folder, used encryption software (VeraCrypt) to create an encrypted container, moved the folder into it, set a strong password, and finally backed up the encrypted container to an external hard drive and a cloud drive, one copy each.

events.name: Compile statistics on the promotion effectiveness of the column
events.description: After the backup was completed, Feng Haoran sat in the study and counted the cumulative new followers gained over the past month for his columns on Zhihu and WeChat Official Accounts (about 500 people), organized the private investment consultation messages received, reviewed the promotion effectiveness of this series of articles, and summarized his personal branding experience.
